mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales below their 3-month moving averages signals a contraction in consumer demand, which depresses corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 950,000 units, it signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 950.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% over the past month), strong employment growth supports consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in real GDP growth above 2.0% and low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%) signals a strong and stable economic environment that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
